description: Inspect or change YDB scheme permissions for a path. The default list action is read-only; grant, revoke, set, clear, chown, and inheritance changes return a plan unless confirm=true.

action.description: Permissions operation to run. Defaults to list, which is read-only and does not require confirm.

configPath.description: Absolute path to an explicit local-ydb config file. Missing, unreadable, oversized, or invalid explicit files fail closed instead of using defaults.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute mutating actions. Omit or false for plan-only output. Not required for action=list.

maxOutputBytes.description: For action=list, maximum UTF-8 bytes returned per stdout/stderr stream. Defaults to 65536.

path.description: Scheme path to manage. Defaults to the configured tenant root.

permissions.description: Permission names for grant, revoke, and set actions. Each item is passed as its own -p argument.

profile.description: Named profile from local-ydb.config.json. Defaults to config.defaultProfile.

subject.description: User or group subject for grant, revoke, and set actions.

name: local_ydb_permissions
